change: Cross autoplay rows using the independent timing engine's float beat, preserving delay behavior and precise scoring deadlines. Queue newly avoided mine columns only while the owned scene has its hook, dispatch each on the next judged-row phase before foreground update, and apply synchronous Lua player writes. The scene attaches this callback and removes it with its pending events on screen End. Mine-hit behavior is unchanged.
controls: The unchanged row control uses a minimal authored chart to reproduce all three retained native boundary clocks through real parsing, timing, gameplay and owned Lua. It rejects an earlier un-crossed row and requires one callback at each float boundary despite the future nanosecond deadline. The unchanged mine control requires all three simultaneous avoided mine messages in native track order on the next update, exact native parameter shape, immediate player writes, foreground update ordering and no duplicate dispatch.
